feature_name: Platform web shell (GIS, session, nav, theme)
summary: Management **webapp shell** (`:app:webApp` `wasmJs` + `:app:shared`): colla theme §7.2, `/entra` with Google GIS (`nonce` + DOM button overlay), in-memory access token + cookie refresh (`http://localhost` local dev aligned with `SameSite=Strict`), URL navigation (Navigation 2 + back-button logout guard), permission-based tabs (incl. `technical` access to `/configuracio` for achievements), user menu, `SessionsScreen` (incl. logout-all), and WasmGC browser fallback. **Web only**.
overview:
Foundation UI slice before feature specs (organigrama, calendari…). Replaces the demo `App()` with the real admin shell talking to `platform-server-auth` via `MuixerangaApi`.

**Source of truth:** `docs/especificacion-tecnica.md` v1.3 §7.1–7.3, §7.5 · `docs/decisiones.md` (Navigation 2, Google GIS, no Firebase, `wasmJs` only in v1).

**Prerequisites**
- `platform-server-infra` + `platform-server-auth` running locally on `http://localhost:8080` (same-site with webpack dev server on `http://localhost:<port>` so `SameSite=Strict` cookies work).
- `platform-core-contract`: `MuixerangaApi`, auth DTOs, `Permission` constants.
- `platform-me-rgpd` plugs into `/configuracio-inicial` and `/el-meu-perfil` (this slice registers routes and exposes `AuthViewModel.onMeUpdated(MeResponse)`).

**Acceptance (slice)**
- `./gradlew :app:webApp:wasmJsBrowserDistribution :app:shared:jvmTest` succeeds.
- Manual E2E: `/entra` → GIS login with `nonce` → token in RAM only (zero `localStorage`/`sessionStorage` token storage) → `GET /me` → home with tabs filtered by `permissions`.
- Reload any deep link (`/calendari`, `/contractacions`) → silent `/auth/refresh` (`credentials: include`) → preserves route and session.
- Logout → revokes session, calls `google.accounts.id.disableAutoSelect()`, clears backstack and replaces browser history so browser «Back» cannot return to protected UI (§10.2).
- `technical` sees `/configuracio` (via `achievements:write` or `config:write`); `member` does not.
- Auth errors `not_invited` / `account_disabled` display exact §7.3 Valencian copy.
- Non-WasmGC browsers display a readable Valencian HTML fallback message before Wasm fails (§7.1).
shared_ui_policy: All shell UI, theme, ViewModels, `SessionManager`, and Navigation 2 live in `:app:shared` (`commonMain` + `wasmJsMain` for GIS/URL/credentials expect/actual). `:app:webApp` only hosts `main()`, `index.html`, `styles.css`, and static assets. Android/desktop/JS are out of v1 scope (keep minimal compile stubs if needed so repo builds).
out_of_scope:
- Feature screens SPEC-01…08 (render Valencian `PlaceholderScreen` until each feature slice lands).
- `:server` changes.
- Android, desktop, JS, iOS clients.
- Full Caddy CSP deployment (already documented in §9.4).
- Mandatory One Tap prompt (optional `google.accounts.id.prompt()`).
- `platform-me-rgpd` form UI (route placeholders + `onMeUpdated` callback hook).

external_systems.name: Google Identity Services
external_systems.role: Script `https://accounts.google.com/gsi/client`; client ID fetched at runtime from `GET /api/v1/auth/config`.

auth.client: GIS ID token (with random `nonce`) → `POST /api/v1/auth/google` (`client: web`, `credentials: include`). Access token in RAM only; proactive + 401 single-flight refresh via `mux_refresh` cookie.

images.caption: Desktop shell: red top bar (#BB2029), colla crest + title, yellow active tab (#FFC432), navy user pill, page header kicker + CTA, and light-grey KPI card container
Desktop user dropdown menu anchored under top-right navy user pill (must render with elevated z-index above page CTAs)
Mobile shell: compact red top bar (crest + TP avatar + active section), horizontally scrollable KPI cards, red + FAB, and 4-tab bottom navigation bar (Calendari, Contractacions, Membres, Més)

components.name: main.kt
components.usage: Read `API_BASE_URL` from `index.html` `<meta name="tabala-api-base-url">` (with build-time placeholder substitution), start Koin, mount `ComposeViewport { TabalaApp() }`.

components.name: index.html & styles.css
components.usage: `lang="ca"`, title «Muixeranga d'Elx — Gestió», `<meta name="tabala-api-base-url" content="...">`, async GIS script, `#google-signin-overlay` / `#google-signin-button` container, WasmGC feature-detection fallback banner + `<noscript>` in Valencian.
components.notes: Fallback HTML login per §7.1 only if Wasm GIS interop hits a blocker (record in `docs/decisiones.md`).

components.name: TabalaTheme + StringsCa
components.usage: Material 3 light-only theme (§7.2): red `#BB2029`, navy `#14005E`, yellow `#FFC432`, white `#FFFFFF`, black `#000000`, bundled Roboto font family (`composeResources/font/roboto_*.ttf`), colla logo resource placeholder, and centralized Valencian string resources (`StringsCa` / `strings.xml`, §7.5).
components.notes: Never load fonts from Google Fonts CDN.

components.name: GoogleSignInBridge (expect/actual)
components.usage: Generate cryptographic random `nonce`, call `google.accounts.id.initialize({client_id, callback, nonce, use_fedcm_for_prompt: true})` and `renderButton(..., {theme: 'outline', size: 'large', text: 'signin_with', locale: 'ca'})`, position/show `#google-signin-overlay` only while on `/entra`, expose `disableAutoSelect()` on logout.
components.notes: Real implementation in `wasmJsMain`; no-op stubs in other targets for build compatibility.

components.name: SessionManager
components.usage: In-memory access token store (`StateFlow`), proactive refresh ~60 s before `expiresIn`, single-flight `Mutex` refresh (prevents concurrent token rotation), Ktor `HttpClient` plugin attaching `Authorization: Bearer` + `credentials: include` on `/auth/*`, 401 single retry then logout, and `SharedFlow` signal on `403 consent_required`.

components.name: AuthViewModel
components.usage: Exposes `StateFlow<AuthUiState>` (`Checking`, `LoggedOut(error?)`, `ConsentRequired(me)`, `Authenticated(me)`). Handles cold-start silent refresh, GIS credential exchange with `nonce`, `onMeUpdated(me)` hook for `platform-me-rgpd`, and logout.

components.name: LoginScreen
components.usage: Route `/entra`: colla logo, «Gestió interna de la Muixeranga d'Elx», reserved visual slot aligned with `#google-signin-overlay`, and exact §7.3 Valencian error panels (`not_invited` with «Prova amb un altre compte», `account_disabled`).

components.name: MainScaffold
components.usage: Official mockup chrome (`decisiones.md`): **red (`#BB2029`) top bar** with colla crest + «Muixeranga d'Elx / Gestió», centered icon+label tabs (active tab yellow `#FFC432` with bottom yellow bar), right navy (`#14005E`) user pill (`TP` + name + role + chevron) opening an elevated dropdown menu («El meu perfil», «Sessions obertes», «Tanca la sessió»). On mobile (<600 dp, min width 360 dp): compact red bar (crest + `TP` avatar + centered section title), white 4-tab bottom navigation bar (`Calendari`, `Contractacions`, `Membres`, `Més` with red top active indicator), and red `+` FAB.
components.notes: Shared reusable UI building blocks: `SectionHeader` (`GESTIÓ INTERNA` red kicker + bold title + subtitle + red `+ ...` CTA), `KpiFilterStrip` (light-grey bordered box with clickable white KPI cards; active card has soft cream fill + `#14005E` border & top stripe; alert cards use soft cream + red value), `RightSideSheet` (overlay edit drawer with sticky `Cancel·la` / `DESA` footer), `CenteredFormModal`, empty state, loading indicator, error banner with «Torna-ho a provar», and 409 conflict dialog.

components.name: AppNavigation + WebHistorySync
components.usage: Navigation Compose 2 with real URL paths synced to `window.location.pathname` / `popstate`. Enforces auth gate (`/entra`), consent gate (`/configuracio-inicial`), permission check per route, and replaces history + clears backstack on logout so «Back» stays on `/entra`.

components.name: SessionsScreen + SessionsViewModel
components.usage: Route `/sessions`: lists active sessions (`clientType`, `userAgent`, `lastUsedAt`, current badge), revoke single session (`DELETE /me/sessions/{id}`), and «Tanca totes les sessions» (`POST /auth/logout-all`).

structure:
Web shell architecture:

```text
app/webApp/main.kt
  → read API_BASE_URL from <meta> (default http://localhost:8080/api/v1 in dev)
  → startKoin(sharedModules)
  → ComposeViewport { TabalaTheme { TabalaApp() } }

State routing:
  Checking        → splash spinner (silent POST /api/v1/auth/refresh)
  LoggedOut       → /entra (LoginScreen + #google-signin-overlay visible)
  ConsentRequired → /configuracio-inicial (ConsentSetupScreen / stub)
  Authenticated   → MainScaffold + NavHost (real URLs synced with History API)
```

Navigation destinations & permission gates:
- `/organigrama` — «Organigrama» (`org-chart:read`)
- `/calendari` — «Calendari» (`events:read`)
- `/contractacions` — «Contractacions» (`contracts:read`)
- `/inventari` — «Inventari» (`inventory:read`)
- `/membres` — «Membres» (`users:read`)
- `/figures` — «Figures» (`figures:read`)
- `/documents` — «Documents» (`documents:read`)
- `/configuracio` — «Configuració» (`config:write` OR `achievements:write`, per `decisiones.md` so `technical` manages achievements)
- `/el-meu-perfil` — «El meu perfil» (always, self)
- `/sessions` — «Sessions obertes» (always, self)
- `/configuracio-inicial` — Setup RGPD (only when `!consent.dataProcessing`)

sections.title: Local dev origin & API_BASE_URL injection
sections.description: Gradle injects `API_BASE_URL` into `index.html` `<meta name="tabala-api-base-url">` via `processResources` token replacement (default `http://localhost:8080/api/v1` in dev; `-PapiBaseUrl=https://api.muixerangadelx.com/api/v1` for production distribution).
sections.behavior: Using `http://localhost` (never `127.0.0.1`) for both webpack dev server and Ktor server ensures cookies are same-site (`SameSite=Strict`) and matches Google Cloud OAuth authorized origins (§4.6).

sections.title: GIS overlay & WasmGC fallback (§7.1)
sections.description: `index.html` runs a small inline WasmGC capability check before loading `webApp.js`; unsupported browsers immediately see a clear Valencian HTML message instead of a blank screen. When Compose is mounted, `#google-signin-overlay` is shown centered over the login card slot only when `AuthUiState` is `LoggedOut`.
sections.behavior: `GoogleSignInBridge` generates a fresh random `nonce` per sign-in attempt, passes it to `google.accounts.id.initialize`, and forwards both `credential` and `nonce` to `AuthViewModel` → `POST /api/v1/auth/google`. Clicking «Prova amb un altre compte» calls `disableAutoSelect()` and re-renders the button.

sections.title: Protected binary fetch helper (for images & files)
sections.description: Provide a reusable helper on `SessionManager` / `MuixerangaApi` (`fetchAuthorizedBytes(url): ByteArray`) that sends `Authorization: Bearer` (with automatic 401 refresh retry) so later feature slices (`members`, `inventory`, `documents`) can render protected images via Compose `ImageBitmap` and trigger `Blob` downloads.
sections.behavior: Public URLs can load normally; protected `/api/v1/files/*` assets never rely on cookies or unauthenticated `` tags.

sections.title: Shared design system & Valencian formatting (§7.2, §7.5 & mockups)
sections.description: Bundle Roboto `.ttf` weights (Regular, Medium, Bold) in `app/shared/src/commonMain/composeResources/font/` and provide `DateTimeFormatCa` (`Europe/Madrid`, `ca-ES`) and `MoneyFormatCa` (`450,00 €`) helpers. Follow the official mockup visual system (`decisiones.md`): red (`#BB2029`) top header, yellow (`#FFC432`) active indicator, navy (`#14005E`) user pill & selected KPI accent, light-grey `KpiFilterStrip`, `RightSideSheet` for entity editing, and `CenteredFormModal` for creation/quick actions.
sections.behavior: Centralize all shell copy in Valencian resources (structured cleanly for `preferredLocale` support). Ensure the top-right user dropdown menu renders in a high z-index popup layer above page CTAs. On mobile (<600 dp), render the compact red bar, horizontal scrollable KPI cards, red `+` FAB, and 4-tab bottom bar with «Més» sheet/menu for secondary destinations (Organigrama, Inventari, Figures, Documents, Configuració).

persistence: No client database. Access token lives strictly in RAM; refresh token lives only in `HttpOnly` cookie managed by the server.
